ai_summary: Aqylon Nexus Limited announced a significant leadership shake-up, with both the Managing Director/Chairperson and Executive Director/CTO resigning simultaneously for stated "personal/professional reasons." The board subsequently appointed Mr. Parth Rajeshbhai Rupareliya, a cousin of an existing director, as the new MD/Chairperson, alongside an additional independent director. This dual executive departure coupled with a related-party appointment for the top leadership role presents a potential red flag regarding corporate governance and could indicate undisclosed strategic changes.
